name: AI Agents & Intelligent Systems
description: Build real-world AI applications using Bifrost by Maxim AI and Tavily. Explore challenges across efficient coding agents, agent benchmarking, autonomous security testing, open-source AI infrastructure, and research automation. Choose one of the six problem statements and develop a working solution that meaningfully integrates both technologies.

problem_statements.name: Build a Coding Agent That Gets the Job Done on the Fewest Tokens
problem_statements.description:
Build an AI coding agent that completes real development tasks while minimizing token consumption and operational costs. The agent must continue working through provider outages, enforce individual spending limits, protect confidential repositories by using local models, and require user approval before performing risky operations such as file writes, shell commands, or Git actions.

The solution should demonstrate efficient and reliable coding workflows without compromising correctness, privacy, or security.

problem_statements.name: Build a Benchmarking Platform for AI Agents, Not Just Models
problem_statements.description:
Build a framework-independent benchmarking platform that evaluates AI agents against identical tasks. The platform must measure task success, execution steps, tool calls, token usage, cost, and completion time across repeated runs.

It should also test how agents respond to failing tools, unavailable models, and misleading instructions, while providing a comparison interface with detailed execution traces to help developers understand agent performance and reliability.

problem_statements.name: Build an Agent That Pentests a Target on Its Own
problem_statements.description:
Build an autonomous AI agent capable of performing authorized penetration testing inside a strictly isolated laboratory environment. The agent must explore permitted targets using real security tools, interpret results, independently decide its next actions, and work toward predefined security objectives.

The solution must strictly respect the provided scope, recover from unsuccessful attempts, and generate actionable security reports containing findings, evidence, severity, and remediation recommendations.

problem_statements.name: Open-Source Bifrost Gateway
problem_statements.description:
Extend the open-source Bifrost gateway with a practical feature that solves a real problem for developers or gateway operators. This could include a plugin, provider integration, caching or routing capability, user interface, or developer tool.

The solution must use supported extension points, work with a standard Bifrost installation, and include clear setup instructions, documentation, and tests. The final contribution should be suitable for consideration as an upstream open-source pull request.

problem_statements.name: Tavily Research Agent
problem_statements.description:
Build an AI-powered research agent that prepares a concise, one-page briefing before a meeting. Given a company or person and a scheduled meeting time, the agent should research relevant developments from the preceding 30 days, including news, launches, hires, and other important updates.

The briefing should provide source-backed findings, useful discussion points, and open questions to help users prepare for meaningful conversations.

problem_statements.name: Build a Stale-Answer Detector for AI Applications
problem_statements.description:
Build an AI-powered verification system that identifies outdated information in LLM-generated answers. The system should detect potentially stale claims involving pricing, API versions, regulations, or company information, re-verify them against live web sources, and provide a freshness score for each claim.

The solution should help users distinguish current, reliable information from potentially outdated AI-generated responses using both Tavily and Bifrost.
